hero.alt: Hundreds of scanned handprints projected onto a railway bridge at night, reflected in the water below

bleed.alt: Aerial view at night of a lit outdoor event site, projections and a glowing dome

sections.heading: Breaking interfaces
sections.blurb: We take the technology people use without thinking - screens, sensors, phones, ticket gates - and bend it into something that makes strangers talk to each other.

sections.heading: Amplifying place
sections.blurb: Work made for one specific street, market, waiting room or station - built with the people who already use it.
